name: Spawner
description: Makes copies of a prefab appear while the game runs — on a click, when a player walks in, on a timer, or when another script asks. The Multiplayer Server decides, so every player sees the same copies in the same place.

changelog.notes: Simpler settings: what sets it off comes from where it sits, spread and marker visibility are automatic, and the trigger list is down to the four that matter.
Wording pass on the settings: every one now says in plain words what the creator sees, and the timer, zone, click and hover settings say which trigger they belong to. No behavior change.
Initial release: five triggers, a server-decided shared alive-set, per-spot cap, lifetime and scatter.
